Automatic code hover from a ggplot expression

Source: R/ch_hover.R
ch_hover.Rd

Takes ggplot code, splits it at every top-level `+`, evaluates each cumulative step, renders one image per step and returns a self-contained hoverable HTML table (CSS and JavaScript travel with it – no template or YAML set-up needed). Hovering a row of code shows the plot as it looks up to that step.

Usage

ch_hover(
  code,
  type = c("incremental", "one_row"),
  layout = c("auto", "row", "column"),
  fixed_scales = FALSE,
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 96,
  path = NULL,
  name = "codehover",
  css_class = "",
  alt = NULL,
  caption = NULL,
  initial = "last",
  env = parent.frame()
)

Arguments

code

The plot code. Either an expression wrapped in braces, as in the example below, or a character string/vector of code lines.

type

(string) Hover effect: "incremental" (default, highlights the hovered row and every prior row) or "one_row".

layout

(string) Placement of the image relative to the code table: "auto" (default) puts them side by side when there is room and wraps the image below otherwise (responsive); "row" forces side by side, shrinking the image if needed; "column" forces the image below the code.

fixed_scales

(logical) Default FALSE: each step shows the true output of its partial code, so axes and legends may change between steps. TRUE pins scales, axes and panel layout from the final plot so the reveal is visually stable (mechanism borrowed from the ggreveal package by Weverthon Machado).

width, height

(numeric) Image size in inches. Default 7 x 5.

dpi

(numeric) Image resolution. Default 96.

path

(string) Default NULL: step images are written to a temporary folder, embedded into the HTML as base64 and deleted. Give a folder path (e.g. "codehover_assets/") to keep numbered PNG files on disk and reference them by relative path instead (smaller HTML, but the folder must ship with the page).

name

(string) File-name prefix for the step images. Default "codehover".

css_class

(string) Extra CSS class added to the container.

alt

(character) Alternative text for the step images, used by screen readers. Either one string per step or a single string reused by every step. Default NULL builds "Plot after step i of n: <code>".

caption

(string) Optional caption shown under the image.

initial

(string or number) Which step's image is shown before any interaction: "last" (default), "first" or a step number.

env

Environment in which the code is evaluated. Default `parent.frame()`.

Value

An htmltools tag list, rendered automatically in R Markdown, Quarto and the RStudio viewer.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  ch_hover({
    ggplot2::ggplot(mtcars, ggplot2::aes(wt, mpg)) +
      ggplot2::geom_point() +
      ggplot2::geom_smooth(method = "lm")
  })
}
